title: Brick breaker
hints: Write `circleRect` first (lesson 1's project has it) and use it for both the paddle and the bricks.
For the overlaps: the ball's bounding square runs from `x - r` to `x + r`; the overlap with the brick on x is `min(right edges) - max(left edges)`.
requirements: Bricks are laid out from text rows with their hit points.
The ball stays on the paddle until launched, bounces off walls, and is aimed by where it hits the paddle.
Exactly one brick is hit per update, and the ball bounces off the side it hit.
Lives, score and game over follow the rules above.
stretch: Add power-ups that fall from destroyed bricks (a wider paddle, a slower ball, an extra ball), and levels loaded from a text file, one block of rows per level.
